rules: Frames, fills, icons, thumbnails, chips, and buttons are separate PNG layers.
No baked UI labels or button text in reusable controls; TMP renders all UI copy.
Frame sprites keep transparent outside corners and are intended for 9-slice import.
Evidence thumbnails are content art only and can be swapped without changing card chrome.

layers.role: separate Unity Canvas layer; no baked reusable UI labels
